### 📖⠄Description

Rename all Sulfur related items and biome into Brimstone (Another name for Sulfur)

Inspired by [Mogswamp](https://youtube.com/shorts/-YguEYsl-A8)

### 🗃️⠄Renamed items and biome

- All sulfur block variant
- All polished sulfur variant 
- All sulfur bricks variant
- Chiseled sulfur
- Potent sulfur
- Sulfur spike (renamed into Pointed Brimstone)
- Bucket of sulfur cube
- Sulfur cude spawn egg
- Sulfur cube
- Sulfur Caves (biome name)
